svg.title: Two kinds of station
svg.desc: Split top-down cartoon. Left, a Python station: the Rust train is stopped at a platform beside a STOP sign. Crab workers carry orange Rust crates off the train, repack them into taped cardboard Python boxes, and load them onto a horse wagon that plods up a dirt road to a wooden station with a clock reading waiting. Steps: stop the train, unload and repack every crate, haul it up and back, repack and reload. Right, a Rust station: an orange station whose canopy straddles the track, with arms reaching down to the cargo while the train rolls between its platforms with motion lines. Steps: roll through the station, work happens on the cargo in place, keep going.
svg.text: Haul it up by wagon, wait, haul it back
Work happens on the cargo, in place
A Python stop means unloading the train onto a wagon. A Rust stop works on the cargo while the train rolls through.
